Notes.Text:
This update for busybox fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-88830: unit confusion in TLS Montgomery reduction buffer allocation causes a pre-authentication heap buffer
  overflow when processing a crafted `ClientKeyExchange` message (bsc#1282575).
- CVE-2026-88831: httpd silently fails open when IP deny rules contain invalid CIDR prefix lengths (bsc#1282550).
- CVE-2026-88832: romfs volume ID parsing uses unbounded `strlen` on attacker-controlled metadata and allows for a heap
  buffer overflow when crafted filesystem images are processed (bsc#1282576).
- CVE-2026-88835: dpkg read_package_field() steps past NUL terminator, causing out-of-bounds read on malformed .deb
  packages (bsc#1282551).
- CVE-2026-88837: httpd misidentifies yescrypt password hashes as plaintext (bsc#1282552).
- CVE-2026-88839: passwd/group parser writes heap pointers out of bounds due to stale tokenize() endpoint (bsc#1282568).
- CVE-2026-88841: OOB read and silent memory corruption of the status file due to `write_status_file()` failing to reset
  the `field_start` cursor between package stanzas (bsc#1282653).
